import subprocess
subprocess.run(["git", "reset", "--hard", "base"], capture_output=True)

with open("src/semver/version.py", "r") as f:
    content = f.read()

# m1: bump_prerelease - correct logic
old_m1 = """        cls = type(self)
        if self._prerelease is not None:
            prerelease = self._prerelease
        elif token == "":
            prerelease = "0"
        elif token is None:
            prerelease = "rc.0"
        else:
            prerelease = str(token) + ".0"

        prerelease = cls._increment_string(prerelease)
        return cls(self._major, self._minor, self._patch, prerelease)"""

new_m1 = """        cls = type(self)
        if self._prerelease is not None:
            prerelease = self._prerelease
            # Check if the last dot-separated segment is purely numeric
            last_segment = prerelease.rsplit(".", 1)[-1]
            if last_segment.isdigit():
                prerelease = cls._increment_string(prerelease)
            else:
                # Non-numeric segment: append .0 for strict ordering
                prerelease = prerelease + ".0"
            return cls(self._major, self._minor, self._patch, prerelease)
        elif token == "":
            prerelease = "0"
        elif token is None:
            prerelease = "rc.0"
        else:
            prerelease = str(token) + ".0"

        prerelease = cls._increment_string(prerelease)
        return cls(self._major, self._minor, self._patch, prerelease)"""

count = content.count(old_m1)
print(f"m1 occurrences: {count}")
content = content.replace(old_m1, new_m1, count)

with open("src/semver/version.py", "w") as f:
    f.write(content)
print("Written")
